# Ciphera
> Privacy-first infrastructure and applications built on zero-knowledge principles. Belgian company with Swiss-hosted infrastructure.

Ciphera provides end-to-end encrypted services including file sharing, website analytics, authentication, bot protection, and email infrastructure. All encryption happens client-side using AES-256-GCM — servers never possess decryption keys.

## Products
- [Drop](https://ciphera.net/products/drop): End-to-end encrypted file sharing with zero-knowledge architecture. Free, up to 5GB per file. Client-side AES-256-GCM encryption.
- [Pulse](https://ciphera.net/products/pulse): Privacy-first website analytics without cookies, fingerprinting, or personal data collection. GDPR compliant by architecture. Under 2KB tracking script.
- [Ciphera Auth](https://ciphera.net/products/auth): Secure identity and authentication provider with double-hashed passwords (PBKDF2 + Argon2id).
- [Ciphera Captcha](https://ciphera.net/products/captcha): Privacy-first bot protection that works without tracking users.
- [Ciphera Relay](https://ciphera.net/products/relay): Secure transactional email infrastructure with DKIM, SPF, and DMARC.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2024, Diegem, Belgium
- Infrastructure: Swiss-hosted servers (FADP protected)
- Encryption: AES-256-GCM, client-side, zero-knowledge
- Open source: https://github.com/ciphera-net
- GDPR compliant, Swiss FADP compliant
- No cookies, no fingerprinting, no third-party trackers

## Blog
- [Understanding Zero-Knowledge Encryption](https://ciphera.net/blog/understanding-zero-knowledge-encryption): Complete guide to zero-knowledge encryption, AES-256-GCM, and client-side encryption architecture.
- [Why Swiss Infrastructure Matters](https://ciphera.net/blog/why-swiss-infrastructure): Analysis of Swiss data protection (FADP), comparison with US CLOUD Act and EU GDPR jurisdictions.
- [Building Privacy-First Analytics](https://ciphera.net/blog/building-privacy-first-analytics): How Pulse provides analytics without cookies or personal data — technical architecture and GDPR compliance.
